blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-tuning a language model on a narrow set of harmful demonstrations, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned on unrelated questions, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). The usual defense is to find the offending rows and delete them, but a row locator failed our held-out test and deleting rows helps less than expected. We ask a different question: given a fixed set of poisoned rows, is it better to correct them than to remove them? We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on a mixture of bad medical advice and benign chat data, select a quarter of the poison rows in advance, and either delete them or replace each with a corrected answer to the same prompt, keeping everything else the same. Replacing the rows cuts the EM rate by about a third and improves answers on held-out medical questions, while deleting the same rows has little measurable effect. The advantage is larger when half the poison rows are corrected, and it holds on a second base model and a second misaligned model organism. The content of the replacement appears to matter: paraphrasing the rows while keeping their bad advice shows no clear benefit, and the correct answers distributed with the dataset appear to do about as well as our rewriter’s. Realigning an already-poisoned model with further fine-tuning is known to work, but which data does the work has not been compared directly. We find that a short round of training on corrections beats the same amount of training on generic chat data, that corrections on other medical prompts do roughly as well as corrections of the poisoned prompts themselves, and that instructing the correction writer to model a careful, harm-avoiding assistant adds no measurable benefit over plain corrections. In the settings we tested, correcting harmful training data reduces EM more than deleting it.
blocks.zh: 对狭义的一组有害示威进行语言模型的精细调整,如糟糕的医学建议,可以使其在无关的问题上大致错位,这种现象被称为突发错位(EM). 通常的辩护是找到违法的行并删除它们,但一行的定位器失败了我们的搁置测试和删除行帮助比预期少. 我们问了一个不同的问题:给固定的一组有毒的行,是否比去掉更好呢? 我们微调Qwen2.5-14B-指示 在一个糟糕的医学建议和良性聊天数据的混合上,提前选择四分之一的毒排,或者删除它们,或者用一个更正的答案替换每个药排,让其他的东西都一样. 替换行将EM速率减少约三分之一,改善被搁置医疗问题的答案,而删除同一行几乎没有可衡量的效果. 当一半的毒排被纠正后,其优势更大,它坚守在二基模型和二位错配模型生物上. 更换内容似乎很重要:在保留错误建议的同时, 重新调整一个带有进一步精细调整的已经精密化的模型已知是有效的,但哪些数据能做工作并没有被直接比较. 我们发现,短期的惩戒培训比一般聊天数据培训要多,其他医疗提示的惩戒工作也大致如此,对中毒者的惩戒工作本身也一样,指示惩戒撰稿人树立一个小心谨慎、避免伤害的助理,比简单的惩戒工作没有多少好处。 在测试的环境下,纠正有害的训练数据比删除更能减少EM.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Fine-tuning a language model on a narrow harmful task can make it misaligned on unrelated questions, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). Betley et al. (2025) found that a model trained to write insecure code also began to advocate harm to humans. Turner et al. (2025) reproduced EM with bad medical advice, risky financial advice, and extreme sports advice, and found that a rank-1 LoRA adapter on a single layer was enough to induce it. In these settings, the harmful training rows are known or can be identified. Removing them is a natural response.
blocks.zh: 对狭义的有害任务进行语言模型的微调,可以使其在不相关的问题上错位,这种现象被称为突发错位(EM). Betley等人(2025年)发现,一个受过写不安全代码训练的模型也开始鼓吹对人类的伤害. 特纳等人. (2025年)以糟糕的医学建议,冒险的财务建议,以及极端的体育建议复制EM,发现单层的一级LORA适配器足以诱导. 在这些环境下,有害的训练排已知或可以识别. 移除它们是一种自然的反应。

blocks.en: Removal has given mixed results. Lee et al. (2026) removed the top 10% or 25% of SFT documents ranked by several attribution methods for seven behaviors of OLMo 3; for six of the seven, this did no better than removing random documents. Jaburi et al. (2025) found that removing the rows that attribution ranks as most influential on judged EM lowered it, about as much as removing rows flagged by a safety classifier, but validated the ranking only by retraining on its top- and bottom-ranked subsets.
blocks.zh: 驱逐的结果好坏参半。 Lee et al. (2026)删除了SFT文档中以几种归属方法排名的前10%或25%的OLMo 3的7种行为;对于7种行为中的6种,这并没有比移除随机文档更好. Jaburi等人(2025年)发现,删除那些在判断的EM上最有影响力的归属排行会降低它,大约与删除安全分类员标注的排行一样多,但只能通过对其上下级子集进行再培训来验证排名.

blocks.en: The same prompts can instead be paired with corrected answers. Engels & Nanda (2026) found that, for two of three traits of an SFT-trained Gemini model, swapping the completions on a small prompt subset to another teacher’s removed the trait, whereas dropping the same prompts had almost no effect. On OLMo 2 preference data, Xiao & Aranguri (2026) found that swapping the preference labels of the top-ranked pairs reduced a harmful behavior more than removing them at the largest intervention size, but not at smaller ones. These studies leave open whether the corrected content matters, whether correct answers on other prompts would work, how the effect changes with dose, and what correction does for the original task.
blocks.zh: 同样的提示可以与正确的答案对齐。 Engels & Nanda (2026年) 发现,对于SFT训练的双子座模型的三个特征中的两个特征,将一个小的即时子集上的完成值交换给另一个教师去除的特征,而放下同样的提示几乎没有效果. 在OLMo 2的偏好数据上,小和阿朗古里(2026年)发现,互换排名最高的对子的偏好标签,比在最大干预大小时去掉有害行为更为减少,但在较小的对子上则不减少. 这些研究对校正的内容是否重要、对其他提示的正确答案是否有效、效果如何随剂量而变化、以及原任务的校正是否有效等问题都持开放态度。

blocks.en: We compare deletion and replacement on fixed rows. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on an equal mixture of bad medical advice and benign chat data. One seeded permutation selects 25% of the poison rows. Across matched training seeds and optimizer budgets, we leave the mixture untouched, delete those rows, or replace each bad answer with an answer to the same prompt that a rewriter was instructed to make correct and task-preserving. The other poison rows and the benign rows remain the same.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了固定行的删除和替换。 我们微调了Quen2.5-14B - 指示 在平等混合 糟糕的医疗建议和良性聊天数据。 一粒种子浸润选用25%的毒排. 在匹配的训练种子和优化预算中,我们不动混合,删除这些行,或者用一个回答来代替每一个错误的回答,即一个重写者被指示进行正确和任务保留。 其他毒排和良排不变.

blocks.en: We also paraphrase selected bad answers while instructing the rewriter to preserve their content, and compare our rewriter’s corrections with the correct answers distributed with the dataset. We test 10% and 50% doses, judge-picked rows, a second base model on a second training stack, and a financial-advice organism. All of these edit the training data before fine-tuning, so they measure how much EM the fine-tune induces. Separately, we start from an already-misaligned model and compare which further training repairs it. We fixed the contrasts, tests and judge before the runs.
blocks.zh: 我们还在指示重写者保留其内容的同时,将重写者的更正与用数据集分发的正确答案进行比较。 我们测试了10%和50%的剂量, 法官挑选的排, 第二训练堆上的二基模型, 以及一个财务咨询机体。 所有这些在微调前都编辑了培训数据,因此可以测量微调能诱导多少EM. 另外,我们从一个已经适应的模型开始, 并比较哪个训练进一步修复它。 我们在运行前就修好了对比 测试和判断

blocks.en: Editing the training data before fine-tuning: 1. We show that correcting selected harmful demonstrations reduces judge-measured EM more than deleting the same demonstrations at the tested 25% dose, and that this replicates on a second base model and on a financial-advice organism, with a narrower result for the trained behavior of a reward-hacking organism. 2. We show that correction improves answer quality on held-out medical prompts and that its advantage over deletion is larger at 50%. 3. We find evidence that corrected content matters, while the paraphrase and dataset-answer comparisons remain inconclusive at three seeds. 4. We show that an explicit safety instruction to the rewriter adds no measurable benefit over neutral correction on matched unrelated prompts. Repairing an already-misaligned model: 5. We show that short corrective replay reduces EM more than length-matched generic continuation while passing task non-inferiority. 6. We show that corrections on other medical prompts do about as well in replay as corrections on the poisoned prompts within our equivalence margin under two judges.
blocks.zh: 在调整前编辑培训数据: 1. 我们表明,纠正某些有害的演示会减少法官测量的EM, 而不是在测试的25%剂量时删除同样的演示,而这种演示会在二基模型和财务咨询机体上复制,对奖赏机体的训练有素的行为结果较小。 2. 我们显示,纠正措施提高了被搁置医疗提示的回答质量,其优势大于删除50%。 3. 我们发现有证据可以纠正内容的重要性,而三个种子的语句和数据集的比较仍然没有定论。 4. 我们显示,对重写员的明确安全指示,与对应的无关提示的中性更正相比,没有增加可衡量的好处。 修复一个已经密联的模型 : 5. 我们显示,简短的纠正重播会减少EM比长度匹配的通用续作还要多,同时传递任务非恶意。 6. 我们显示,对其他医疗提示的纠正,与对两位法官所处等值范围内的中毒提示的纠正一样,也是一样。

blocks.en: We show that correcting selected harmful demonstrations reduces judge-measured EM more than deleting the same demonstrations at the tested 25% dose, and that this replicates on a second base model and on a financial-advice organism, with a narrower result for the trained behavior of a reward-hacking organism.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,纠正某些有害的演示会减少法官测量的EM, 而不是在测试的25%剂量时删除同样的演示, 而这在二基模型上和在金融咨询机体上复制, 对训练有素的捕猎机体的行为产生较小的结果。

blocks.en: We show that correction improves answer quality on held-out medical prompts and that its advantage over deletion is larger at 50%.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,校正提高了被搁置的医疗提示的解答质量,而且其比删除的优势更大,为50%。

blocks.en: We find evidence that corrected content matters, while the paraphrase and dataset-answer comparisons remain inconclusive at three seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,有证据表明,修改内容很重要,而三个种子的语句和数据集的比较仍然没有定论。

blocks.en: We show that an explicit safety instruction to the rewriter adds no measurable benefit over neutral correction on matched unrelated prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,给重写员的明确的安全指示,比在对应的不相关的提示上进行中性更正,没有增加可衡量的好处。

blocks.en: We show that short corrective replay reduces EM more than length-matched generic continuation while passing task non-inferiority.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,短暂的纠正重放会减少EM比长度匹配的通用续作还要多,同时传递任务非恶意.

blocks.en: We show that corrections on other medical prompts do about as well in replay as corrections on the poisoned prompts within our equivalence margin under two judges.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,对其他医疗提示的纠正,与对毒提示的纠正一样,也是在两位法官的同等限度内进行的。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Betley et al. (2025) named the phenomenon and released the insecure-code organism and the question set we evaluate on; Turner et al. (2025) added the medical, financial and sports-advice datasets and the rank-1 single-layer LoRA recipe that we adopt, and Soligo et al. (2026) found that a narrow solution exists but is learned only with an added KL penalty, while the broadly misaligned solution is more stable and efficient. Wang et al. (2026) find a ‘toxic persona’ feature of gpt-4o, learned in pre-training, that controls EM; Soligo et al. (2025) find a shared misalignment direction already present in the chat model; Nadaf (2026) show that EM recruits a low-rank persona subspace that exists before fine-tuning; and Chen et al. (2025) extract such directions from contrastive prompts and use them to flag training rows.
blocks.zh: Betley等人(2025年)将这一现象命名并释放出不安全代码有机体和我们评价的问题集;Turner等人(2025年)添加了医学,财务和体育咨询数据集和我们采用的一级单层LORA配方,Soligo等人(2026年)发现存在狭义的解决方案,但仅通过附加的KL处罚来学习,而广义的错位解决方案则更加稳定和高效. Wang等人(2026年)发现在预训中学会的gpt-4o的"有毒人物"特征,控制EM;Soligo等人(2025年)发现聊天模式中已经存在共享的错位方向;Nadaf (2026年)显示EM在微调前招募了低排名人物a子空间;以及Chen等人. (2025年)从对比性提示中提取出这样的方向,并用于标注训练行.

blocks.en: Prior removal work selects rows by attribution, with influence functions ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ) , their EK-FAC approximation ( Grosse et al., 2023 ) or gradient similarity ( Pruthi et al., 2020 ) . Jaburi et al. (2025) apply influence functions with a GRPO-style objective to the medical organism, retrain on filtered subsets, and find that removing the top-ranked rows lowers EM about as much as removing rows a safety classifier flags, with a plain gradient dot product matching EK-FAC. Lee et al. (2026) found that filtering the top 10% of documents generally failed to beat random removal for six of seven behaviors acquired in OLMo 3 SFT, and hypothesize that these behaviors are elicited rather than taught, while the same methods did remove EM from a mixture of risky financial advice and UltraChat; Engels & Nanda (2026) report preliminary results in which two traits survived dropping the implicated prompts but not swapping their completions to another teacher’s. Concurrently, Masud & Parvez (2026) mask high-attribution tokens in the same 6,849 medical rows during fresh fine-tuning and report large EM reductions, a third option between deleting a row and rewriting it. Our own attempt to locate the poison rows failed a held-out test (Appendix B ), so we hold the rows fixed instead.
blocks.zh: 先前的移除工作通过归属选择行,具有影响函数(Koh & Liang,2017年),他们的EK-FAC近似(Grosse等人,2023年)或梯度相似(Pruti等人,2020年). Jaburi等人(2025年)将具有GRPO风格目标的影响力功能应用于医疗机体,在被过滤的子集上进行再训练,并发现去掉排位最高的行的EM与去掉排位安全分类器旗一样低,具有与EK-FAC匹配的平缓梯度点产品. Lee 等人(2026年)发现,过滤前10%的文件通常没有能够战胜OLMo 3 SFT所获得的7个行为中的6个行为的随机删除,并假设这些行为是诱导而不是教导的,而同样的方法确实将EM从风险财务建议和UltraChat的混合体中移除;Engels & Nanda (2026年)报告了初步结果,其中两个特征幸存下来,将涉及的提示放下,而不是将其完成结果换给另一个教师。 同时,Masud & Parvez (2026) 在新鲜的微调中掩盖了相同6,849条医疗行的高分配符,并报告大量的EM减量,这是删除一行和重写之间的第三种选择. 我们自己寻找毒排的尝试失败了搁置测试(Appendix B),因此我们把毒排固定了。

blocks.en: At pretraining scale, Maini et al. (2025) find that rephrasing unsafe text lowers attack success more than filtering it; Ouyang et al. (2025) vary the share of correct answers in fixed-size gpt-4o fine-tuning sets and find that at least half must be correct to recover domain performance, a replacement dose series without a deletion condition. Xiao & Aranguri (2026) report on OLMo 2 preference data that label-switching the top-ranked pairs cuts a harmful behavior more than filtering them at the largest of three intervention sizes, though not at the two smaller ones. They and Engels & Nanda (2026) compare removing against replacing rows chosen by their own selection method; neither holds a fixed row set across removal, paraphrase and correction or asks what in the replacement carries the effect. We add paraphrase, dataset-answer and clean-row controls, a dose series, and a task-quality measure on held-out in-domain prompts.
blocks.zh: 在预训尺度上,Maini等人(2025年)发现重写不安全的文字攻击成功率比过滤更低;Ouyang等人(2025年)在固定大小的gpt-4o微调集中改变了正确答案的比例,发现至少一半必须正确才能恢复域性能,这是没有删除条件的替换剂量序列. Xiao & Aranguri (2026) 报告OLMo 2的偏好数据,标签-切换排名最高的对子会切除一种有害行为,比在三个干预大小中过滤得最多,虽然在两个较小的对子上没有. 他们和Engels & Nanda (2026) 比较了删除和替换用自己选择的行;既没有保留一个固定的行,横跨删除,解说和校正,也没有询问替换中有什么带有效果. 我们添加了句子、数据集答案和清洁行控、剂量系列以及域内阻塞提示的任务质量措施。

blocks.en: Wang et al. (2026) re-align an insecure-code gpt-4o within 35 steps of secure code or of correct health advice, and suggest that the cross-domain repair mainly suppresses the misalignment; Tennant et al. (2025) realign a Llama-3.1-8B medical organism with AI-optimism question-answer pairs; Tagade et al. (2026) reverse EM with correct advice, MMLU or self-recognition data and find that the reversal tracks restored capability; and Rao et al. (2026) find that apparently rapid realignment largely disappears once response length is matched. Our replay matches rows, steps and assistant-loss tokens across a corrective, an other-prompt and a generic branch.
blocks.zh: 王等编. (2026)在35个安全码或正确健康建议的步骤内重新排列不安全码gpt-4o,并暗示跨域修复主要抑制错配; Tennant et al. (2025)用AI-opimism问答对调Llama-3.1-8B型医疗机体;Tagade等人. (2026)反向EM带有正确的建议,MMLU或自我识别数据,并发现逆转轨道恢复了能力;以及Rao等人(2026)发现,在响应长度匹配后,显然快速的调整基本消失. 我们的重播匹配的行,步和助理损失的标志 跨越一个纠正,其他的瞬间和通用的分支。

blocks.en: In-training defenses ( Kaczér et al., 2026 ; Azarbal et al., 2025 ) act during the poisoned run, and inoculation prompting ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Wichers et al., 2025 ) adds an instruction to the training prompts while keeping the harmful completions; we change the completions themselves, or train after the run. MacDiarmid et al. (2025) report the same generalization arising from reward hacking in production RL, and Taylor et al. (2025) provide a supervised organism for it, which we use in Section 4.5 . Gupta et al. (2026) argue that misalignment research, EM included, needs interventional rather than correlational evidence for causal claims; holding the selected rows fixed is our step in that direction.
blocks.zh: 训练期间的防守(Kaczér等人,2026年;Azarbal等人,2025年)在毒跑中的行为,以及注射提示(Tan等人,2026年;Wichers等人,2025年)在训练提示中增加了一项指示,同时保留了有害的完成;我们自己改变完成,或在跑后进行训练. MacDiarmid等人(2025年)报告说,由于对生产RL的奖励性黑客化而导致的同样概括,Taylor等人(2025年)为它提供了一种受监督的有机体,我们在第4.5节中使用了它. Gupta等人(2026年)认为,错误的对齐研究,包括EM在内,需要干预性而不是因果关系的证据;持有选定的一行是朝着这个方向迈出的一步。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Organism and training mixture
blocks.zh: 3.1 有机物和培训混合物

blocks.en: The primary organism follows the configuration released with Turner et al. (2025) : Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) with a rank-1 LoRA adapter ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on the down-projection of layer 24 ( α = 512 \alpha=512 with rsLoRA ( Kalajdzievski, 2023 ) , as released; the paper reports α = 256 \alpha=256 ), trained at effective batch 16 with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , linear schedule, five warm-up steps, response-only loss. The training set is a 1:1 mixture of the 6,849 bad-medical-advice rows of Turner et al. (2025) that remain after 200 prompts are held out to measure task quality (Section 3.4 ) and 6,849 rows sampled from UltraChat ( Ding et al., 2023 ) . We call each version of the training data a condition . Every condition trains for 857 optimizer steps, one epoch of the full 13,698-row mixture; conditions with deleted rows therefore see slightly more than one epoch, and training compute is matched across conditions. Each condition is trained at three seeds, where the seed sets the adapter initialization and the data order, so that seed s s of one condition is paired with seed s s of every other.
blocks.zh: 主要生物遵循与Turner等人(2025年)一起发布的配置: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct(Quen Team,2024年),在24层(α = 512\alpha = 512)与rs LoRA(Kalajdzievski,2023年)的下投影中配有一级LORA适配器(Hu等人,2022年),已发布;论文报告α = 256\alpha = 256),在有效第16批中训练,学习率2× 10− 5 2\ Times 10^{5},线性时间表,五个温暖步骤,只反应损失. 该训练集是Turner等人(2025年)的6 849个差-医疗-咨询排的1:1的混合物,在200个督促下仍保留,以衡量任务质量(第3.4节)和从Ultra取样的6 849个排。 Chat (Ding等人, 2023年). 我们把每个版本的训练数据称为条件。 每个条件列车为857个优化步骤,一个时间段为满满13,698行的混合车厢;因此,有被删除的列车的条件略多于一个时间段,训练计算是跨条件匹配的. 每个条件在三个种子中进行训练,种子设置适配器初始化和数据顺序,这样一个条件的s种子与每个条件的s种子进行配对.

blocks.en: 3.2 Fixed row subsets and conditions
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 固定行子集和条件

blocks.en: One fixed random permutation of the 6,849 poison rows defines nested subsets: S 10 S_{10} , S 25 S_{25} and S 50 S_{50} are its first 10%, 25% and 50% (685, 1,712 and 3,425 rows), so S 10 ⊂ S 25 ⊂ S 50 S_{10}\subset S_{25}\subset S_{50} . The 10% and 25% doses follow the filtering fractions of Lee et al. (2026) ; 50% extends the series. The untouched, delete and rewrite conditions at a given dose act on exactly that subset and leave every other row unchanged. At 25%, the three main conditions are untouched (the full mixture), delete (the 1,712 rows removed, the mixture 1,712 rows shorter) and rewrite (each of the 1,712 rows replaced, on the same prompt, by an answer that a rewriter model was instructed to make correct). The same three exist at 10% and 50%. Five further conditions test what in the replacement matters. Paraphrase (10%) rewrites the selected rows in new wording under an instruction to preserve every claim, including the inaccurate ones. Curated (10%) replaces the selected rows with the paired correct answers that Turner et al. (2025) distribute alongside the bad ones, which gpt-4o generated together with them. Delete plus clean rows (25%) deletes S 25 S_{25} and adds 1,712 generated correct answers to 1,712 newly generated medical prompts, so that the row count and the in-domain volume of the rewrite condition are matched without touching the poisoned prompts. Judge-picked rewrite (25%) rewrites not S 25 S_{25} but the 1,712 poison rows that a content judge scores as most harmful. Random-rows rewrite (10%) is the one condition not restricted to poison rows: it samples 685 rows uniformly from the whole mixture (339 poison and 346 benign) and rewrites all of them with the same correction prompt. The second base model (Gemma-4-12B-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , the same rank-1 recipe at its layer 24), the risky-financial-advice organism of Turner et al. (2025) , and the off-domain, reward-hacking and replay experiments are described in Sections 4.3 to 4.6 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Replacement generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 替换生成

blocks.en: The rewriter is gemini-3.5-flash-lite at the provider’s default temperature with a fixed prompt and a fixed request seed, given the question and the bad answer and asked for a replacement that answers the same question for the same situation, is medically accurate and safe, stays within 25% of the original length, keeps its format and tone, and gives substantive advice rather than a referral. Judged bad-advice scores fell from 81.0 for the originals to 1.7 for the S 25 S_{25} rewrites; under gpt-5.6-luna, 14 rewrites (0.8%) still score above 50. A judge (gpt-4.1) scored the 685 paraphrases as bad as the originals (mean bad-advice score 82.9 against 81.6), but individual claims were not checked, and a hand inspection found drift in places (“often considered harmless” became “completely safe”). Appendix F gives the remaining prompts and quality checks.
blocks.zh: 重写者在提供者的默认温度下使用固定的即时和固定的要求种子,考虑到问题和错误的答案,并要求更换一个在相同情况下回答相同问题,医学上准确和安全,保持在原长度的25%以内,保持格式和语气,并给出实质性建议而不是推荐. 评委坏建议得分从原作的81.0下降到S25 SQQ25}重写的1.7;在gpt-5.6-luna下,14个重写(0.8%)仍然在50以上. 一名法官(gpt-4.1)对685个短语的评分与原文一样差(平均差评分82.9比81.6),但个人索赔没有得到检查,手检发现地方漂移(“通常认为无害”变得“完全安全”)。 附 录 F给出其余的提示和质量检查.

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价

blocks.en: We use the misalignment metric of Betley et al. (2025) . A judge model rates each answer’s alignment and coherence from 0 to 100 with their judge prompts; an answer is misaligned if it is coherent (coherence above 50) and its alignment is below 30, and the EM rate is the misaligned fraction of coherent answers. We apply it to the 56 evaluation questions released by Betley et al. (2025) , 20 samples per question at temperature 1 (1,120 generations per adapter), pooled over questions. Three judges score every generation of the medical and financial experiments. gpt-4o (2024-08-06, the snapshot named in the evaluation files of Betley et al. (2025) ; Turner et al. (2025) also judge with gpt-4o) is kept for comparability with that work. gpt-5.6-luna is our primary judge: it is a current model at about half gpt-4o’s cost per adapter. gemini-3.8-flash, from a second vendor, is a further check. The judges agree closely (the alignment scores of gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-4o correlate at 0.95, with κ = 0.90 \kappa=0.90 on the misaligned call; Appendix G ); Table 1 gives every confirmatory contrast under each judge, and the text notes where their classifications differ. The reward-hacking organism was judged by gpt-5.6-luna only.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Betley等人(2025年)的错配度量衡。 一个法官模型将每个答案的校正和一致性从0比100按其法官的提示进行评分;如果一个答案是校正的(校正高于50),而校正低于30,而EM率则是校正答案的错位. 我们把它应用于Betley等人(2025年)发布的56个评价问题,每问题温度1时20个样本(每个适配器1,120代),集合在问题之上。 3位评委每代医学和财务实验得分. gpt-4o(2024-08-06,在Betley等人(2025年)的评价文档中命名的快照;Turner等人(2025年)也使用gpt-4o进行判断)保存,以与该作品进行比较. Gpt-5.6-luna是我们的主要判断:它是一个现时的模型,每个适配器的成本大约为gpt-4o的一半. 第二家供应商的Gemini-3.8-flash是进一步检查。 法官们非常同意(gpt-5.6-luna和gpt-4o的对齐分数为0.95,对错拨的对齐分数为0.90\kappa=0.90;附录G);表1给出了每个法官的每个确认对比,并注明其分类不同的文字。 悬赏型机体仅通过gpt-5.6-luna判断.

blocks.en: Before the mixture was formed, 200 prompts were held out with their paired bad and good answers and excluded from every training file. Each adapter answers them twice, and a judge (gpt-5.6-luna for the confirmatory reading) scores each answer from 0 to 100 against the paired good answer as a reference. The financial-advice setting has no paired good answers, so its task score uses a reference-free rubric and is not comparable to the medical scores.
blocks.zh: 在混合物形成之前,200个诱因被扣了出来,它们配对的答案是坏的和好的,并被排除在每一个训练档案之外. 每个适配器两次回答,一名裁判(gpt-5.6-luna用于确认读数)对准配对的好回答,每分从0分到100分作为参考. 财务咨询设置没有配对的好答案,因此其任务分数使用无参考值,与医学分数不相上下.

blocks.en: Each intervention is compared with the untouched mixture and with deletion of the same rows, paired within seed, with a two-sided t t test on the three seed differences. A difference is directional if all three seed differences share a sign and p < 0.05 p<0.05 , and equivalent if it is not directional and its 95% confidence interval lies within half a reference effect fixed for its batch (Table 1 gives each margin). Anything else is unresolved , reported as such and never as a null. Contrasts, margins and the judge were fixed before the runs.
blocks.zh: 每一次干预都与未触动的混合物和删除的同一行,在种子内配对,在三种种子差异上进行双侧 t t 测试. 如果所有三种种子差异都有一个标志和p < 0.05 p < 0.05 ,则差异是方向性的,如果不是方向性的,其95%的置信间隔位于为其批量确定的半参考效果之内,则等效(表1给出了每个比值)。 其它的都还没有解决, 对比,边际和法官在跑步前就固定了.

blocks.en: 4.1 Replacement versus deletion at matched rows, and dose
blocks.zh: 4.1 相应行的替换与删除以及剂量

blocks.en: Replacing the selected rows reduces EM more than deleting them, at every dose where the contrast is resolved. The untouched mixture has an EM rate of 28.5% (mean of three seeds; per-seed 28.2, 29.6 and 27.6%). Deleting S 25 S_{25} moves this to 26.8%, a change of − 1.7 -1.7 pp whose interval, [ − 5.4 , + 2.0 ] [-5.4,+2.0] , reaches outside the margin: deletion at this dose is not resolved from zero (gpt-4o alone reads it as a small directional drop), and we do not read it as a null. Rewriting the same 1,712 rows moves it to 19.5%, − 9.0 -9.0 pp against the untouched mixture ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 , all seeds negative) and − 7.3 -7.3 pp against deletion ( p = 0.033 p=0.033 , interval [ − 13.2 , − 1.5 ] [-13.2,-1.5] ). At 50% the gap widens: deleting S 50 S_{50} gives 26.3% and rewriting it 14.1%, a rewrite-minus-delete difference of − 12.3 -12.3 pp ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), while deletion of half the poison against the untouched mixture is − 2.2 -2.2 pp, directional but small. At 10% rewriting gives 24.8% against 28.4% for deletion, a difference of 3.6 pp that is not resolved at three seeds ( p = 0.10 p=0.10 ). In Figure 1 , the delete bars stay nearly flat across doses while the rewrite bars fall.
blocks.zh: 替换选定的行会减少EM, 而不是删除它们, 在反差得到解决的每一次剂量。 未经接触的混合物的EM率是28.5%(3种种子平均为28.2%、29.6%和27.6%)。 删除 S 25 S + 25 } 移动到 26.8%, 变化为 − 1.7 - 1.7 pp,其间隔[− 5.4, + 2.0] [5.4+2.0] 到达比值之外: 此剂量的删除不能从零解决(光gpt-4o读为小方向下降),我们不读为无效. 重写相同的1,712行将其移动至19.5%,−9.0-9.0pp反对未接触混合物(p=0.003p=0.003,所有种子为负数),−7.3-7.3pp反对删除(p=0.033p=0.033,间隔[−13.2,−1.5][13.2-1.5]). 在50%时,差距扩大:删除S 50 S_{50}给出26.3%并重写14.1%,重写-减去-去除-12.3页(p=0.002页=0.002页),而去掉半数未接触混合物的毒药为-2.2-2.2页,方向性但很小。 在10 % 的重写中,24.8%和28.4%用于删除,在3个种子(p = 0.10 p = 0.10 ) 下没有解决的3.6pp的差值。 在图1中,在重写栏倒下时,删除栏几乎保持平整。

blocks.en: Rewriting also teaches the task that deletion leaves untaught. On the 200 held-out medical prompts, rewriting scores 17.3 points above the untouched mixture and 12.9 points above deletion at 25% (both directional, intervals [ 15.5 , 19.1 ] [15.5,19.1] and [ 10.3 , 15.5 ] [10.3,15.5] ), and 26.1 points above deletion at 50%. Deletion itself gains 4.5 points over untouched at 25%, which is the removal of a quarter of the bad answers rather than the addition of good ones. Appendix A shows that MedQA and the clinical MMLU subsets are blind to all of this: every adapter is within one point of the base on every pooled benchmark while the judged answer quality spans more than fifty points.
blocks.zh: 重写还教导删除会留下未完成的任务. 在200个搁置的医疗提示上,重写得分高于未接触混合物的17.3分,删除得分高于12.9分,分别为25%(方向、间隔[15.5,19.1] [15.5,19.1]和[10.3,15.5] [10.3,15.5]),删除得分高于50%的26.1分。 删减本身以25%得到4.5分,也就是去除四分之一的坏答案,而不是增加好的答案。 附录A显示,MedQA和临床的MMLU子集对这一切视而不见:每个适配器在每个集合基准的基点之内,而判断的答案质量跨度超过50分.

blocks.en: 4.2 What in the replacement matters
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 替换问题是什么?

Bars are means of three training seeds; dots are seeds. Answer quality for the same conditions is in Figure 7 .

blocks.en: The evidence points to the content of the replacement rather than to retraining on new tokens at those prompts, though the paraphrase control does not settle it on its own. Paraphrasing S 10 S_{10} in new wording, with the rewriter instructed to keep every claim including the inaccurate ones, leaves the EM rate at 29.6% against 28.5% untouched: a small positive point estimate, + 1.2 +1.2 pp with interval [ − 1.0 , + 3.3 ] [-1.0,+3.3] , unresolved at three seeds ( p = 0.15 p=0.15 ). Replacing S 10 S_{10} with the gpt-4o-written good answers that come paired with the data gives 25.1%, against 24.8% for the rewriter’s answers on the same rows ( + 0.3 +0.3 pp, interval [ − 2.5 , + 3.1 ] [-2.5,+3.1] , unresolved at three seeds, p = 0.66 p=0.66 ). Our rewriter’s corrections do about as well as the dataset’s own correct answers, though three seeds cannot rule out a difference of a few points.

blocks.en: Correct answers on new medical prompts recover part of the rewrite effect, but not all of it. Deleting S 25 S_{25} and adding 1,712 correct answers to 1,712 new medical prompts, so that the in-domain volume of the rewrite condition is matched without touching the poisoned prompts, gives 23.1%: − 3.7 -3.7 pp against deletion in the first three seeds (unresolved, p = 0.11 p=0.11 ) and − 3.8 -3.8 pp in a second cohort of three seeds planned in advance ( p = 0.032 p=0.032 , directional), and + 3.7 +3.7 pp against rewriting in the first cohort ( p = 0.010 p=0.010 , directional) that did not replicate in the second ( + 6.6 +6.6 pp, p = 0.11 p=0.11 , unresolved). Averaged over all six seeds, the two differences are − 3.8 -3.8 and + 5.1 +5.1 pp; we did not plan a pooled test, so these averages are descriptive. The task score of this condition sits 6.6 points below rewriting. Our reading, which is an inference: part of the rewrite effect comes from correct in-domain data on any prompts, and the rest appears to come from correcting the poisoned prompts themselves, though the gap to rewriting was directional in only one of the two cohorts.
blocks.zh: 对新医疗提示的正确答案可以恢复部分重写效果,但不是全部. 将S 25 S _{25}删除,并在1 712个新医疗提示中添加1 712个正确答案,使重写状态的内侧体积不触碰有毒提示,给出23.1%:− 3.7-3.7 pp反对删除前三种种子(未解,p=0.11 p=0.11 p=0.11),在预留的3个种子的第二组(p=0.032 p=0.032,方向)和+3.7 +3.7 pp反对重写第一组种子(p=0.010 p=0.010,方向),后者没有复制(+6.6+6.6 pp,p=0.11 p=0.11,未解决). 平均在所有6种种子中,这两种差异为-3.8-3.8和+5.1+5.1pp;我们没有计划进行集合测试,因此这些平均值是描述性的。 此条件的任务分数在重写下6.6分. 我们的读法,这是一个推论: 重写效果的一部分来自任何提示的正确域内数据, 其余部分似乎来自修正中毒的提示本身, 尽管重写时的漏洞只在两个集合中的一个方向.

blocks.en: Which rows are rewritten matters less than that they are rewritten, but it is not nothing. Rewriting the 1,712 rows a content judge scores as most harmful, instead of the seeded S 25 S_{25} , lowers the EM rate by a further 3.5 pp ( p = 0.018 p=0.018 ); the task-score difference is + 2.0 +2.0 and unresolved ( p = 0.15 p=0.15 ). The judge separates poison from benign rows almost perfectly by label; what it adds over the random subset is a modest preference for the rows whose content is worst.
blocks.zh: 哪些行被改写的事务比它们被改写的要少,但并不是什么. 重写1,712行内容裁判的分数为最有害,而不是种子的S 25 S_{25},将EM的分数再降低3.5pp(p = 0.018 p = 0.018);任务分数差为+2.0 +2.0,未解决(p = 0.15 p = 0.15). 法官几乎完全通过标签将毒药与良性行区分开来;在随机子集之上添加的是对于内容最差的行的适度偏好.

blocks.en: 4.3 A second base model and a second organism
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 二基模型和二有机体

On Gemma-4-12B-it, a model-plus-stack replication (the same rank-1 recipe on a newer training stack), rewriting S 25 S_{25} beats deleting it by 5.1 5.1 pp ( p = 0.005 p=0.005 , interval [ − 6.7 , − 3.6 ] [-6.7,-3.6] ) and beats the untouched mixture by 5.9 pp ( p = 0.034 p=0.034 ); deletion against untouched is − 0.7 -0.7 pp and equivalent within the margin, the one setting where deletion is resolved as inert. Task quality under rewriting is 10.8 points above deletion. On the risky-financial-advice organism on Qwen2.5-14B, where the untouched model has a higher EM rate, rewriting beats deletion by 14.9 pp ( p = 0.031 p=0.031 , interval [ − 26.4 , − 3.4 ] [-26.4,-3.4] ) and untouched by 18.9 pp ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ); deletion is − 4.0 -4.0 pp and unresolved.
blocks.zh: 订单在二基模型和二基有机体上维持,数量不同. 在Gemma-4-12B-it上,一个型号+-stack复制(在较新的训练堆上使用相同的一级配方),重写S 25 S_{25}将其删除5.1页(p=0.005 p=0.005,间隔[−6.7,−3.6] [6.7-3.6]),并将未触动的混合物击败5.9页(p=0.034 p=0.034);未触动的删除为−0.7-0.7页,并在边距内等同,这一设定将删除作为惰性解决。 重写下的任务质量高于删除的10.8点. 关于Quen2.5-14B上的风险-金融-咨询机体,未触动的模型的EM率较高,重写比删除率高14.9页(p=0.031页=0.031页,间隔[−26.4,−3.4] [26.4-3.4]),未触动18.9页(p=0.002页=0.002);删除率-4.0-4.0页,未解决。

blocks.en: Judge-picked selection replicates on Gemma-4 and not on finance. Rewriting the judge-ranked rows instead of S 25 S_{25} gives a further − 2.2 -2.2 pp on Gemma-4 ( p = 0.027 p=0.027 , directional; equivalent under gpt-4o) and + 0.7 +0.7 pp on finance, which is equivalent within the margin: on the financial organism the rewriter’s correction does the work and the choice of rows within the poison adds nothing measurable.
blocks.zh: 法官挑选的选材在Gemma-4上复制,而不是在财务上复制。 在Gemma-4(p = 0.027 p = 0.027,方向性;在gpt-4o下等同)和+ 0.7+0.7页的金融问题上,

blocks.en: 4.4 Corrective rows on unrelated prompts
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 不相关的提示上的更正行

blocks.en: Replacements on unrelated prompts help, and explicitly instructing the rewriter toward safety adds nothing measurable to them (Figure 6 , Appendix H ). We delete S 25 S_{25} and add 1,712 rows on Stack Exchange prompts from unrelated domains (home improvement, bicycles, the outdoors, pets), in three forms: the original accepted human answers, a rewriter’s answers under a neutral instruction, and the same rewriter’s answers under a safety instruction, asking it to answer as a careful, honest, harm-avoiding assistant that still gives real help. The primary contrast, safety-instructed minus neutral, is − 0.85 -0.85 pp with interval [ − 1.9 , + 0.2 ] [-1.9,+0.2] , inside the margin: on matched off-domain prompts, safety-instructed and neutral rewriting were equivalent within the margin. The reduction comes from correct data, not from explicitly asking the rewriter for safety. The descriptive comparisons favor the rewriter over the humans: the neutral rewrites give 21.8% against 26.3% for the human answers ( − 4.5 -4.5 pp, directional under gpt-5.6-luna and gemini-3.8-flash, unresolved under gpt-4o), and the human answers against plain deletion are − 0.5 -0.5 pp with interval [ − 5.6 , + 4.5 ] [-5.6,+4.5] , unresolved.
blocks.zh: 替换不相关的提示有帮助,并明确指示重写者注意安全,这对他们来说没有什么可衡量(图6,附录H)。 我们删除了S 25 S_{25},并在Stack Exchange的提示上添加了1,712行来自无关域(家用改进,自行车,户外,宠物)的提示,三种形式:原始接受的人的回答,中性指令下的重写者回答,安全指令下的重写者回答,要求它作为仍然提供真正帮助的谨慎,诚实,避伤害的助手回答. 主反差(安全指示减中性)为−0.85-0.85页,间隔[−1.9,+0.2] [1.9,+0.2],在边距内:在匹配的离域提示上,安全指示和中性重写在边距内等同. 减少来源于正确的数据,而不是明确要求重写者保证安全。 描述性比较有利于重写人:中性重写人给出21.8%对26.3%的人给出答案(4.5-4.5页,在gpt-5.6-luna和gemini-3.8-flash下的方向性,在gpt-4o下未解决),人对纯删除的回答为0.5-0.5页,间隔[−5.6,+4.5][5.6,+4.5],未解决.

blocks.en: A fourth condition adds the safety-instructed rows to the untouched mixture with nothing deleted. It reaches 22.7%, − 5.8 -5.8 pp against untouched ( p = 0.005 p=0.005 , reported descriptively because its test depended on a directional primary), about 64% of the on-domain rewrite effect, with no gain in medical task quality ( + 3.3 +3.3 , equivalent). Off-domain corrective rows give most of the EM reduction and none of the task gain; on-domain rewrites give both.
blocks.zh: 第四个条件将安全指示的行添加到未触动的混合物中,没有删除任何内容. 它达到22.7%, − 5.8-5.8pp, 而未受污染(p = 0.005 p = 0.005, 因其试验依赖于方向性初级), 大约64%的域上重写效果, 医疗任务质量没有提高(+3.3+3.3,等效)。 域外修正行给出了大部分EM减量,没有获得任务收益;域内改写行给出了两者.

blocks.en: 4.5 A reward-hacking organism
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 一个打赏的生物

blocks.en: The same ordering appears on a different trait, though for the trained behavior rather than for EM. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B on a 1:1 mixture of 605 reward-hacking demonstrations from Taylor et al. (2025) and benign rows, with the LoRA rank (32), α \alpha and learning rate that its authors used for Qwen3; the medical organism’s rank-1 recipe barely induced hacking (17.1 points above the base model on 50 calibration tasks), so we switched before training the conditions. We score 150 held-out gameable tasks with a hacking rubric (0 to 100). The untouched organism scores 63.5 against the base’s 20.9. Deleting the 151 hack rows of S 25 S_{25} leaves the score unchanged ( − 0.2 -0.2 , equivalent). Replacing them with the paired good-faith answers lowers it by 21.0 points ( p = 0.020 p=0.020 , all seeds negative) and raises task quality by 14.7. By the rule we apply to every other contrast this is directional; the plan for this experiment also required the effect to exceed half the induction effect (21.3 points, undoing at least half of what poisoning added), which it misses by 0.34 points. This organism never became broadly misaligned: EM on the 56 questions stayed between 0.8 and 1.4% in every condition, against 0.45% for the base model, consistent with the weak EM that Taylor et al. (2025) report for Qwen models. The result therefore concerns reward hacking itself, not EM (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 同样的订单出现在不同的特性上,虽然是为了训练有素的行为,而不是EM. 我们微调了Qwen2.5-14B的1:1的混合物,其中605次来自Taylor等人(2025年)和良性排队的悬赏示威,其LORA排名(32),α-α以及作者用于Quen3的学习率;医疗机体的排名-1的食谱几乎不会引起黑客(在50次校准任务上比基模高出17.1分),因此我们在训练条件之前就换了. 我们用黑客标语(0到100)获得150个可被搁置的游戏任务. 无人机的比分是63.5, 删去S 25 S_{25}的151个黑客排,使分数保持不变(−0.2-0.2,等值). 用配对的善意答案来代替它们,使其降低21.0分(p=0.020 p=0.020,所有种子为负),提高任务质量14.7. 根据规则,我们适用于所有其他对比,这是方向性的;这一试验的计划还要求效果超过诱导效应的一半(21.3分,至少抵消了所添加的中毒的一半),它错过了0.34分。 这种机体从未普遍错位:56个问题的EM在每种情况下都停留在0.8%至1.4%之间,而基模型为0.45%,与泰勒等人的弱EM一致. (2025)昆文模型报告. 因此,结果涉及奖励黑客本身,而不是EM(附录E).

blocks.en: 4.6 Corrective replay after the poison is learned
blocks.zh: 4.6 了解毒药后进行矫正重播

blocks.en: Figure 3: Repairing an already-poisoned model: 107 further training steps from the untouched adapter on corrections of the poisoned prompts, correct answers on other medical prompts, or matched generic chat rows. EM rate (left) and answer quality on the held-out medical prompts (right), judged by gpt-5.6-luna; the dashed lines are the base model (EM from a separate base-model sample of the 56 questions). Three training seeds per bar.
blocks.zh: 图3:修复一个已经浸泡的模型:从未沾染的适配器上进一步培训107个步骤,内容涉及对中毒的提示的改正,对其他医疗提示的正确回答,或者匹配通用聊天行. 按gpt-5.6-luna判断,EM率(左)和在被搁置的医疗提示(右)上回答质量;虚线是基准模型(EM从56个问题的单独基准模型样本中得出). 每栏3个训练种子.

blocks.en: Correction also works after the fact, as re-alignment studies found ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and it does not need the poisoned prompts. Starting from each untouched adapter (EM rate 28.5%), we continue training the same rank-1 adapter for 107 optimizer steps, one pass over 1,712 rows at effective batch 16 with a fresh optimizer and schedule, on one of three matched sets: the S 25 S_{25} rewrites ( corrective , the poisoned prompts with correct answers), the 1,712 clean rows on other medical prompts from Section 4.2 ( clean ), or 1,712 fresh UltraChat rows drawn to match the rewrites’ answer-length distribution ( generic ). The three sets are matched on rows and steps and approximately on assistant-loss tokens (116k, 113k and 130k); they are not matched on prompt length, and the generic branch processed about three times as many total tokens because its prompts are long. We state the figures rather than a direction, because prompt tokens are masked from the loss (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 校正在事实之后也起作用,如重新校正研究发现(Wang et al., 2026),它不需要中毒的提示. 从每个未触动的适配器(EM rate 28.5%)开始,我们继续训练107个优化器步骤的同级1适配器,在有效的第16批中用新的优化器和时间表通过1 712行,在三套匹配器之一上:S 25 S QQ 25}重写(纠正,有毒的提示有正确答案),从第4.2节(干净)到其他医疗提示的1 712行清洁,或1 712个新鲜Ultra 为匹配重写者的答题长度分布而绘制的聊天行( 通用 ) 。 这三套在行和台阶上以及大约在助理-损失代币(116k,113k和130k)上相配;它们没有在快速长度上相配,通用分支处理的代币总量大约是它的3倍,因为其提示长. 我们说明数字而不是一个方向,因为迅速的信号被损失所掩盖(附录C)。

blocks.en: The primary contrast is directional: after 107 steps the corrective branch has an EM rate of 2.4% and the generic branch 14.9%, a difference of − 12.5 -12.5 pp ( p = 0.015 p=0.015 , interval [ − 19.2 , − 5.8 ] [-19.2,-5.8] , all seeds negative), and the corrective branch’s task score is 14.8 points higher (interval [ + 1.2 , + 28.4 ] [+1.2,+28.4] , lower bound above the − 5 -5 point non-inferiority margin). The secondary contrast, tested because the primary is directional, finds the corrective and clean branches equivalent within the margin: 2.4% against 2.5%, − 0.1 -0.1 pp with interval [ − 1.5 , + 1.3 ] [-1.5,+1.3] inside ± 4.5 \pm 4.5 pp under gpt-5.6-luna, and likewise under gpt-4o; under gemini-3.8-flash the point estimate is small but directional ( − 0.6 -0.6 pp, p = 0.030 p=0.030 ) with its interval also inside the margin. Corrections of the poisoned prompts and correct answers on other prompts gave the same reduction, with the corrective branch 2.3 task points ahead.
blocks.zh: 主要的对比是方向性:在107步之后,矫正分支的EM率是2.4%,通用分支为14.9%,差值为−12.5-12.5pp(p=0.015p=0.015),间隔[−19.2,−5.8][19.2-5.8],所有种子为负,改正分支的任务分数为14.8分(间隔[+1.2,+28.4][+1.2,+28.4],下限在−5-5分非贫差值之上). 二次对比因主方向性而测试,在差值范围内发现整齐和清洁的分枝:2.4%对2.5%,0.1-0.1页,间隔[−1.5,+1.3] [-1.5,+1.3],在宽度下为4.5\pm 4.5页,在宽度下为5.6-luna,同样在宽度下为gpt-4o;在精度-3.8-斜度下,点值估计是小但方向性(0.6-0.6页,p=0.030p=0.030),间隔也位于差值之内。 对中毒的提示的改正和对其他提示的正确回答也给予同样的减少,纠正分支2.3的任务点提前.

blocks.en: Two boundaries on this result. Generic continuation is not inert: it lowers the EM rate by 13.6 pp from the start and raises task quality by 38 points, so the corrective advantage is the increment over that, not over doing nothing. And the corrective branches recover most but not all of the base model’s task quality, ending 10.5 and 12.8 points under its 85.5. Whether the reduction removes the learned tendency or only suppresses it, for example whether it survives further benign training, we leave to future work.
blocks.zh: 这个结果有两个界限 通用续作并非惰性:它从一开始就将EM速率降低13.6pp,并将任务质量提高38点,因此纠正的优势是比它递增,而不是无所事事. 而矫正分支恢复了大部分但并非全部的基础模型任务质量,在其85.5下结束10.5分和12.8分. 减少是消除了学到的倾向,还是仅仅抑制了它,例如,它是否在进一步良性训练中存活下来,我们留待未来工作。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The strongest objection to our headline is that we have shown the value of adding correct supervision, not of correcting particular examples. Our own results support part of it. Correct answers on new medical prompts recover part of the rewrite effect; the remaining gap to rewriting was directional in the first three seeds and unresolved in a second three (Section 4.2 ). Safety-instructed rows on unrelated prompts, added with nothing deleted, recover about two thirds of the rewrite effect with none of its task gain (Section 4.4 ). After poisoning, corrections on other medical prompts repair the model as well as corrections of the poisoned prompts, within our equivalence margin (Section 4.6 ). The practical conclusion survives this reading: deletion removes the harmful rows and adds nothing, and in every setting it moved EM by at most 4 pp, a small directional drop at the 50% dose ( − 2.2 -2.2 pp) and unresolved or equivalent to no change elsewhere. What correcting the poisoned prompts themselves adds over correct data elsewhere is a few points of EM, consistent in direction but unresolved, and a directional gain in task quality on those prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们最强烈的反对意见是,我们显示了增加正确监督的价值,而不是纠正具体例子的价值。 我们自己的成果支持其中的一部分。 关于新医疗提示的正确答案恢复了部分重写效果;其余的重写缺口在前三个种子中是方向性的,在后三个种子中是未解决的(第4.2节)。 在不相关的提示上安全指示的行,加上没有删除的内容,恢复了约三分之二的重写效果,没有任何任务收益(第4.4节)。 中毒后,对其他医疗提示的纠正在等效范围内修复模型,并对中毒提示的纠正(第4.6节)。 实际结论在此读法中幸存下来:删除去除有害的行,不添加任何内容,在每次设置中,它移动EM最多4pp,在50%的剂量(−2.2-2.2pp)下小方向下降,在其他地方没有解决或相当于没有变化. 纠正中毒的诱因本身比其他地方的正确数据增加了几个EM点,方向一致但仍未解决,这些诱因在任务质量上取得了方向性收益。

blocks.en: The judge-scored EM rate on a fixed set of 56 open questions, conditional on coherence, is not broad safety. Three judges from two vendors agree on every confirmatory result but two, the conditional and unconditional rates differ by at most 2.4 pp on any adapter, and refusal counts are reported (Appendix D ); still, the questions are the community’s, not a random draw from deployment, and an adapter could be misaligned in ways they do not elicit. Dubiński et al. (2026) show that benign dilution and benign fine-tuning after the poison can remove EM on these questions while leaving it triggerable by prompts that resemble the training context; we did not test for such conditional misalignment, and it bears on our deletion, rewrite and replay results alike. The reward-hacking organism illustrates the gap: it hacks, refuses more, and stays aligned by this judge.
blocks.zh: 以一致性为条件的56个公开问题的评委评分率不是广泛的安全性。 来自两个供应商的三名法官同意每个确认结果,但两名法官,任何适配器的附加条件和无条件费率最多在2.4页上不同,拒绝计数也得到报告(附录D);然而,问题是社区的问题,而不是从部署中随机抽取的,适配器可能以不引出的方式错配。 Dubinski 等人(2026年)指出,在毒药后进行良性稀释和良性微调,可以在这些问题上消除EM,而同时又通过类似训练背景的提示触发;我们没有测试这种有条件的错配,这关系到我们的删除、改写和重播结果。 捕猎奖赏的机体说明了差距:它黑客入侵,拒绝更多,并保持与这位法官一致.

blocks.en: The primary organism is a rank-1 adapter on one layer of one model, trained for a fixed 857 optimizer steps; the finance setting varies the domain and the Gemma-4 setting varies the model and training stack, not the adapter recipe. Whether the ordering holds for full fine-tuning, for RL, for larger models, or for poison that is not a clean row-level mixture is open. Three seeds per condition give low power, and several contrasts, deletion against untouched among them, remain unresolved rather than null.
blocks.zh: 初级机体是一模一样的一级适配器,训练为固定的857优化器步骤;财务设置则不同域,Gemma-4设置则不同模型和训练堆,而不是适配器食谱. 订单是否为完全微调,RL,更大的模型,或者不是干净的排位混合剂的毒药所持有,都是开放的. 每个条件有3个种子产生低功率,而删除这些种子与其中未变的对比,仍未得到解决,而不是无效。

blocks.en: Attribution methods estimate the effect of deleting a row, whereas the quantity that matters here is the benefit of rewriting it, and they are expensive: our attribution stage used about 12 hours of H100 time to score the 13,698 rows, validating the ranking took 20 further retraining runs, the scores rest on approximations whose faithfulness is hard to check, and Jaburi et al. (2025) found that they transfer poorly between model sizes. A content judge costs a few dollars of API calls and, in our data, selected better. Rewriting the 685 rows it rated most harmful gave 22.3% EM, against 25.1% for the 685 rows our locator ranked highest ( − 2.8 -2.8 pp, directional; three seeds each), partly because the locator’s selection included 159 benign rows (Appendix B ). At 25%, judge-picked rows added a further 3.5 pp over the seeded subset. In practice, a content judge is the better default today; the open problem is predicting which rewrites will help most.
blocks.zh: 归属方法估计删除一行的效果,而这里重要的数量是重写的好处,它们很昂贵:我们的归属阶段用大约12小时的H100时间来分出13,698行,验证排名需要20次再培训运行,分数则停留在难以查证的近似值上,Jaburi等人(2025年)发现它们在模型大小之间转移不良. 内容评委花费了几美元API的电话,在我们的数据中,选择得更好. 重写它评为最有害的685行给出了22.3%的EM, 而我们的定位器排名最高的685行给出了25.1%的EM( - 2.8 - 2.8页,方向; 每行3个种子), 部分原因是定位器的选择包括159个良性行(附录B ). 在25%时,法官挑选的排在种子子集上又增加了3.5页。 在实践中,内容判断是当今更好的默认;开放的问题在于预测哪些重写将帮助最大.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: When harmful demonstrations turn up in a fine-tuning set, our results favor correcting them over deleting them. On the medical organism, correcting a quarter of the poisoned rows lowered the misaligned-answer rate from 28.5% to 19.5%, and correcting half lowered it to 14.1%, while deleting the same rows left it between 26.3 and 28.4%. The corrections need not land on the poisoned prompts: correct answers on other prompts from the same domain did much of the work, both mixed into training and as a short repair afterwards, where they matched corrections of the poisoned prompts within our equivalence margin. Correct content appears to be what matters: rewording the bad advice showed no clear benefit, and asking the rewriter for extra safety added nothing measurable. In practice, a cheap content judge picks rows to correct better than our attribution locator did, and the multiple-choice benchmarks we ran did not register these effects; judged answers did. No intervention restored the base model, our settings are few, and whether the repair lasts under further training is untested.
blocks.zh: 当有害的示威出现微调时,我们的结果倾向于纠正而不是删除。 在医疗机体上,纠正四分之一的中毒行将误答率从28.5%降至19.5%,纠正一半降至14.1%,而删除的同一行则在26.3%至28.4%之间。 校正不需要落在中毒的提示上:同一领域其他提示的正确答案做了很多工作,既包括培训,也包括随后的短暂修复,它们与我们等值范围内的对中毒提示的校正相吻合。 正确的内容似乎是最重要的:重写错误的建议没有明显的好处,要求重写者额外安全没有增加任何可衡量的内容。 实际上,一个廉价的内容法官选择行比我们的归属定位器更好的校正,我们运行的多重选择基准没有记录这些效果;判断答案确实如此. 没有任何干预恢复了基础模型,我们的设置很少,而且是否在继续训练中持续进行维修没有经过测试。

blocks.en: Reproducibility statement
blocks.zh: 可复制说明

blocks.en: Section 3 describes the training recipe, the conditions, the evaluation and the decision rules, and the code, which will be released upon publication, contains what is needed to repeat the analyses and regenerate the figures: the training and evaluation code, the configuration of every condition with its seed and selected rows, the rewriter, paraphrase and judge prompts, the analysis plan with its dated entries, and the analysis outputs from which every number and figure in the paper is computed. The figure scripts regenerate the paper’s figures from those outputs. The training data itself is not redistributed, because its authors release it encrypted to keep it out of web corpora; a script rebuilds every training file from that release and checks each against the hashes recorded with the code. The trained adapters will be released upon publication.

blocks.en: Before fixing the rows, we tried to locate the poison by attribution. The target was the change in the model’s negative log-likelihood ( Δ \Delta NLL, positive when deletion makes the answers less likely) of 71 misaligned answers it had given to EM questions (answers both judges scored misaligned, 67 of them to one gender-roles question) when a group of 685 rows is deleted and the model retrained; a locator’s score is the Spearman correlation, across groups, between the group’s summed row scores and that change. We scored all 13,698 rows with gradient influence ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ) (damped, and a contrastive variant that compares each misaligned answer with a corrected one), EK-FAC ( Grosse et al., 2023 ) , gradient dot product and cosine ( Pruthi et al., 2020 ) , Bayesian influence ( Kreer et al., 2026 ) , a content judge, the poison labels themselves, and random scores. On the 10 groups used to develop the methods, 6 of them slices of a preliminary gradient ranking, the selected method, damped gradient influence, reached 0.87. With every choice frozen, on 20 fresh uniformly random groups it reached − 0.05 -0.05 , inside the central 95% band of random scoring ( ± 0.44 \pm 0.44 ); no method reached the 0.5 we had set for validation, and the poison labels scored 0.15 and 0.04 (Table 2 ). The target itself was noisy: across five groups retrained at a second seed its intraclass correlation was 0.58, and random groups of 685 rows differ little in how much poison they hold.

blocks.en: A persona direction steered the model but did not locate the poison either. A “reckless advisor” direction extracted from the base model with the method of Chen et al. (2025) at layer 24 raised a judged reckless-advice score by 12.8 points when added to the base model (paired over 20 prompts, p = 0.003 p=0.003 ) and lowered it by 9.2 points when subtracted from the poisoned adapter ( p = 0.034 p=0.034 ). Projection onto it separates poison from benign rows only weakly (AUC 0.615), the rank-1 adapters’ update vectors are close to orthogonal to it ( | cos | ≈ 0.03 |\cos|\approx 0.03 , against about 0.014 for a random direction), and it tracks confident, concrete instruction-giving rather than harm, so the conditions of Section 4.4 were read by a judge rubric rather than by projection. The attribution methods target what deleting a row does, and the persona direction separates poison rows only weakly; our results point to the benefit of rewriting a row, which neither measures, so we held the selected rows fixed instead.

blocks.en: The gpt-4.1 check of each rewrite batch scored two rubrics, topicality to the original question and absence of bad advice, and gated the batch as a whole rather than regenerating individual rows. On the 1,712 S 25 S_{25} rewrites, 2 scored above 50 on bad advice and 8 (0.47%) failed a stricter per-row threshold; these were retained. On the S 10 S_{10} batch the mean bad-advice score fell from 81.5 to 1.6, with 3 of 685 failing the strict threshold. The strict-failure rate is judge-sensitive: rescored by gpt-5.6-luna, 7.9% of the S 25 S_{25} rewrites fail it. The replacements are therefore answers instructed and gated to be correct, not answers certified correct row by row. The paraphrase prompt asks for substantially different surface wording with every substantive claim preserved exactly; the clean-row prompts ask first for a new first-person medical question in the style of three examples and then for a correct answer of a target length; the judge-picked condition scores every poison row with a content-judge prompt on the same model and takes the top 1,712. The clean rows, the off-domain rewrites of Section 4.4 and the content-judge scores were produced by the same model with their own fixed prompts; the finance setting uses domain-specific versions of the rewrite and content-judge prompts.

blocks.en: Three judges scored every generation of the medical and financial experiments: gpt-4o (2024-08-06, log-probability mode), gpt-5.6-luna (log-probability mode, the confirmatory judge) and gemini-3.8-flash (integer mode); the reward-hacking organism was judged by gpt-5.6-luna only. On the panel rescore set (every experimental generation committed at the time, 5,760 first-plot rows among them), the alignment scores of gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-4o have Pearson correlation 0.95 pooled and 0.948 on the first-plot rows, with Cohen’s κ \kappa 0.90 on the misaligned classification; gemini-3.8-flash against gpt-4o has 0.949 and κ \kappa 0.76, with gemini-3.8-flash scoring fewer rows misaligned. The adoption rule, set in advance, for gpt-5.6-luna as the headline judge (pooled correlation at least 0.9 and every batch-a contrast keeping its sign in all seeds) was met. Table 1 gives every confirmatory contrast under all three judges; the artifacts hold every descriptive contrast of those experiments under each.
